kpi.manuringNote: 715.84 of 1,071.17 mt applied, May 2025–Apr 2026 (PA Table 9); Agro Feb 2026: mature Mix B 396.4 of 891.7 mt (44%), RP 104.8 of 167.24 mt (63%)

notes: Harvest & collection items are the RM/t printed in PA Table 15 (sub-total excl. external transport RM94.65/t vs RM90.64 budget).
Upkeep items are calc: PA Table 6 RM amount / 17,029.48 t actual FFB (budget / 20,425 t budget FFB); they add to the printed 161.18 / 137.71.

General charges items are calc from Appendix 1 RM amounts. Table 17 charges only RM2,027,832 of the RM2,219,159.53 general charges to FFB (budget RM2,114,755.42 of RM2,438,382, which equals the mature 1,102.51 / 1,271.23 ha planted share). Each item is scaled by the same ratio as its total (actual 0.9138, budget 0.8673) and divided by FFB, so items add to 119.08 / 103.53 (printed 119.08 / 103.54, rounding). Charging the full RM2,219,159.53 would give RM130.31/t.
The actual GC allocation (RM2,027,832) does not exactly match the mature-area share (1,102.51 / 1,203.71 ha = RM2,032,587); the basis is not stated.
Table 17 group RM/t add to 412.79 vs printed total 412.78 (rounding). Text 9.1 and 13.11 call the RM412.78 'per hectare'; Table 17 shows it is per tonne FFB.

notes.text: Land preparation complete, planting in progress, expected complete by June 2026; palm count not yet updated.
Cost from start RM544,971 (RM4,827/ha); upkeep RM34,618 (RM306/ha).
Called 25C, 99.38 ha (Table 2) or 104.59 ha (5.2.1); some terraces narrow and collapsing on steep ground; seedlings from Paitan nursery.

summary: FY2025/26 (May 2025–Apr 2026) crop 17,029.48 t, 15.45 t/ha: 17% below the 20,425 t budget (18.53 t/ha) but up from 12.40 t/ha a year earlier (PA).
Cost RM412.78/t vs RM373.09 budget (+11%), driven by low crop and roads RM1,019.76/ha vs RM612.31 budget; total spend was below budget (PA).
Manuring only 67% done (715.84 of 1,071.17 mt); Division B about three Mix B rounds behind in Feb; last Apr-26 round carried to FY2026/27 (PA, Agro).
Harvesters short: 56 vs 73 required; circle spraying 59% and selective 37% of programme after heavy Nov–Mar rain (PA).
Yield up about 32% to Feb 2026 but 2012B (8.90) and 2013B (9.76 t/ha) lag, with low SPH, Mg deficiency and slow rehab recovery (Agro).

issues.title: Cost of production called 'per hectare'
issues.detail: PA 9.1 and 13.11 say total cost was RM412.78 per hectare; Table 17 shows RM412.78 per tonne FFB (budget RM373.09/t). Compare the CEO comments page reply which correctly says per ton.

issues.title: 2025B new planting area: 112.89 vs 99.38 vs 104.59 ha
issues.detail: PA Tables 1/2 (Apr 2026): 2025B 112.89 ha in 7 sub-blocks (B29C 16.28, B35C 8.40, B36C 5.18 plus B30C-B33C), total planted 1,279.53 ha. Agro Tables 1/2 (Feb 2026): 2025/25C 99.38 ha in 6 sub-blocks (B29-C 7.00, B35-C 9.35, no B36-C), total planted 1,266.02 ha; Agro 5.2.1 and Table 12 say 104.59 ha, and Table 12 shows felling done on 112.89 ha (107%). Agro 2.2 text says 1,226.02 ha planted vs its own Table 1 1,266.02.

issues.title: PA area text vs Table 1
issues.detail: PA 2.3 says immature area increased to 117.02 ha and unplantable area reduced to 592.55 ha; Table 1 shows immature 177.02 ha and un-plantable 479.66 ha (plus roads 128.61, buildings 59.20).

issues.title: Circle spraying total: 59% / 1.10 rounds vs 73% / 1.46
issues.detail: PA Table 7: 1,608.26 of 2,205.02 ha programme = 72.9% and 1.46 rounds on 1,102.51 ha, but table and text 6.1.3.2 print 59% and 1.10 rounds. 2013A row 717.43/817.44 = 88%, printed 92%. Dashboard keeps printed 59%.

issues.title: Manuring balance column: 361.05 vs 355.05 mt
issues.detail: PA Table 9 October'25 RP row: delivered 94.90, applied 77.00, but balance printed 23.90 (should be 17.90). Balance column totals 361.05 mt; delivered 1,070.89 minus applied 715.84 = 355.05 (required minus applied = 355.33). Every other row's balance = delivered - applied.

issues.title: Weeding progress PA vs Agro
issues.detail: PA Table 8 (to Apr 2026): selective 1,224.95 of 3,307.53 ha (37%); circle 1,608.26 of 2,205.02 ha. Agro Table 9 (10 months to Feb 2026): selective 2,617.48 of 1,154.85 ha programme (227%), circle 992.73 of 2,309.70 ha (43%). Programmes and done-to-date differ widely; Agro figures may include immature/rehab areas but basis not stated.

issues.title: Manuring programme: Mix B mature 846.08 vs 891.7 mt
issues.detail: PA Table 9 mature Mix B rows sum to 846.08 mt; Agro Table 5 mature Mix B programme 891.7 mt. Immature CPD 28.03 mt (PA) vs 38.77 mt (Agro); immature Mix B 2.16 vs 4.86 mt. PA Table 9 also labels a row OCTOBER'26 (IMMATURE) inside FY2025/26.

issues.title: Pruning progress 100% (PA, Apr) vs 67% (Agro, Feb)
issues.detail: PA Table 10: 2,243.41 of 2,205.02 ha done (100%) by Apr 2026. Agro Table 8: progressive pruning 1,467.08 ha (67%) at Feb 2026, based on payments. Implies about 776 ha in two months; Agro also mislabels it FY24/25.

issues.title: Harvester requirement: 73 (shortfall 17) vs '10 more'
issues.detail: PA Table 4: 56 harvesters vs 73 required (-17). PA 4.2 and 13.2 say an additional 10 harvesters are required.

issues.title: Harvester productivity table and text
issues.detail: PA Table 14 lists 2012B twice (1.52 and 1.67 t/man-day); the second is presumably 2013B. Text 7.6 says earnings ranged RM79.90 to RM91.85/day; table minimum is RM75.90 (2013A).

issues.title: Upkeep % vs budget wrong in text
issues.detail: PA 6.1.4.8 says weeding RM210.34/ha is '9% of the annual budget' (it is 91% of RM229.99, i.e. 9% below). 6.3.4 says pests & diseases RM22.54 is 3% above budget; vs RM16.11 it is 40% above. 6.4.3 says pruning RM178.84 is 84% above; vs RM102.98 it is 74% above. 6.6.3 says drains RM19.05 is 45% of RM45.13; it is 42%. Table 6 'Cost Per Ton' row shows 41,368 in the annual budget column instead of 137.71.

issues.title: General charges text vs Appendix 1
issues.detail: PA 5.6e says weighbridge overspend RM3,687 (465); Appendix 1 shows weighbridge RM4,057 over (128%) - RM3,687 is Other Building Maintenance (146%). 5.6a says staff EPF RM10,060 over; Appendix 1 shows RM10,068. Table 5 management budget RM733.22/ha vs text 5.2 RM733.17; Table 5 Other Expenses annual budget RM25.59/ha vs to-date RM24.59 on the same RM31,262 and 1,271.23 ha.

issues.title: General charges in COP: RM2,027,832 vs RM2,219,159.53
issues.detail: PA Table 17 charges RM2,027,832 (RM119.08/t) general charges against FFB; Table 5 total is RM2,219,159.53. Budget RM2,114,755.42 equals the mature-area share of RM2,438,382, but the actual allocation basis is not stated. Full charge would be RM130.31/t.

issues.title: Agro yield mean 13.59 t/ha basis unclear
issues.detail: Agro Table 13 MEAN 13.59 (FY24/25 10.31). Simple average of the four fields is 13.22 (9.93) and area-weighted on Table 2 areas 13.74 (10.35); neither matches. PA FY2025/26 full-year yield 15.45 t/ha on 1,102.51 ha.

issues.title: Agro SPH / density tables
issues.detail: Agro Table 3 total current SPH 85 vs previous 92 with 0 difference and the same 107,564 palms (85 is 107,564/1,266.02); Table 2 grand total says 92. Appendix 2(a) prints SPH 1.00 for every 2012B field and SPH 117 for field 13 and 106 for field 15 (Table 2: 110 and 103). Agro Table 4 new planting total 236.16 ha vs the single 131.57 ha row.

issues.title: Sprayer numbers inconsistent
issues.detail: PA 4.4: 18 sprayers (14 mature + 4 immature, 6.1.1); 6.1.2: 12 working (8 Div A, 4 Div B); 6.1.3.4 and 6.1.4.3: teams of 4 (Div A) and 2 (Div B).

actions.item: Recruit harvesters (56 vs 73 required; PA asks for 10 more)
Expedite manuring (67% of FY2025/26 programme); seek PARAS agronomist revision
Carry unapplied Apr-26 Mix B stock into FY2026/27 programme (Aug)
Improve fertiliser transport to field and raise manuring output above 13–20 bags/day; use wheelbarrows where possible
Catch up circle (59%) and selective (37%) spraying; eradicate Lalang, Pennisetum, Giant Paspalum
Crusher-run surfacing and grading of agricultural roads (quarry on estate)
Increase mini-crawler mechanised infield collection; consider outsourcing internal transport
Stop unripe bunch harvesting and long stalks; collect loose fruit at platforms (13B-05)
Remove VOPs from circles, inter-rows and collection platforms
Correct Mg deficiency in hilly areas; supervise manuring on hanging terraces
Continue census and selective thinning of close-planted ravine palms
Supply/infill 2024B to at least 130–136 SPH; merge small sub-blocks
Establish legume cover fast on narrow/collapsing 2025B terraces
Pay progressive pruning quarterly instead of twice a year
Remove only dried fronds (over-pruning seen); improve frond stacking

kb:
MILLIAN LABAU PLANTATION 5 ESTATE (MLP 5), United Malacca Berhad (UMB), Sabah. Fact pack from PA Report 1/2026 (Planting Advisor En. Adnan Bin Mustafa, visit 5-6 May 2026, previous visit 29-30 Oct 2025, review period May 2025 to April 2026 = FY2025/26, 12 months) and Agronomy Report 1/2026 (Junior Agronomist En. Alison Bin Janari, Senior Agronomist Mr Chong Kuan Ming; visit 10 Feb 2026, previous visit 8 Aug 2025; covers manuring programmes FY2025/26 and FY2026/27). Estate Manager Mr Benjinus Robin (Benjinus Bin Robin, M12, on estate since 01.11.2024). Senior Manager Mr Celestine Sipilis (Agro: Celestine Bin Siplis), who joined the PA visit on day two. Both covers are headed United Malacca Berhad. Financial year runs May to April.

AREA (PA Table 1, as of April 2026): title 1,947.00 ha. Mature 1,102.51 ha (87% of planted): 2012A 225.45 ha (108 SPH), 2013A 408.72 ha (101), 2012B 230.69 ha (79), 2013B 237.65 ha (69). Immature 177.02 ha: 2024B 64.13 ha and 2025B 112.89 ha. Total planted 1,279.53 ha (66% of title), up from 1,166.64 ha because of the 112.89 ha 2025B rehabilitation planting. Roads 128.61 ha, un-plantable 479.66 ha, buildings/others 59.20 ha. PA text 2.3 says immature rose from 64.13 to 117.02 ha and unplantable fell to 592.55 ha (table shows 177.02 and 479.66). Rehab planned for 64.00 ha in FY2026/27 (PA 2.5). Division A 634.17 ha and Division B 645.53 ha (PA 6.1.2). Division A = fields A01-A21 (2012A, 2013A); Division B = B22-B38 (2012B, 2013B) plus all immature.
AREA (Agro Tables 1-4, as of Feb 2026): mature 1,102.51 ha (57.0% of gross), immature (new planting) 163.51 ha, total planted 1,266.02 ha (65.40%); roads 128.61, ravine/steep hill/forest 493.17, pond 0.43, building and settlement 5.1, riparian reserve 53.67, total unplanted 680.98 ha. Agro calls the 2025 planting 25C at 99.38 ha in 6 sub-blocks with no B36-C (Table 2), and 104.59 ha in 5.2.1 and Table 12. Agro text 2.2 says 99.38 ha newly cleared and 1,226.02 ha declared planted. Agro 2.3: a further 131.57 ha of vacant land planned for FY26/27 (Table 4 total printed 236.16 ha). Palms 107,564 (Table 3): 12A 24,320, 12B 18,120, 13A 41,311, 13B 16,299, 24B 7,514. Age profile: 13% aged 0-3 years (163.51 ha), 87% aged 8-19 (1,102.51 ha) prime mature; Agro says strong yield potential. Low-SPH sub-blocks: A12 51, A18 75, A16 85, A05 87, B36 48, B32 62, B22 67, B28 72, B25 58, B37 37, B38 31.

STAFF (PA section 3): Estate Manager, Sr Assistant Manager Syril Philip, Assistant Manager Pius Bin Jali, 3 field conductors (one joined Nov 2025), chief clerk, 2 general clerks, storekeeper, mechanic. Adequate; PA recommends 1 more field conductor because terrain is steep and remote.

LABOUR (PA Table 4, April 2026): 131 workers vs 139 required (-8); 1 more than last visit's 130; 1 worker per 10 ha, adequate. Harvesters 56 vs 73 required (-17), 5 fewer than 61 at last visit, 1 per 20 ha mature; PA says 10 more are needed (hilly, steep, some areas lack terraces). No infield collectors. Internal transport 4/4, weeding mature 14 vs 20, manuring 11 vs 15 (1 per 116 ha, adequate), immature OP 5, weeding immature 4, mandore 4 vs 5, security 2 vs 3, pruners 4, general workers 10. 18 sprayers (1 per 71 ha incl. immature), also deployed to manuring.

GENERAL CHARGES (PA Table 5 and Appendix 1, FY2025/26): RM2,219,159.53 = RM1,843.61/ha on 1,203.71 ha weighted planted (budget RM2,438,382 = RM1,918.13/ha on 1,271.23 ha), 9% below budget. Management and supervision RM851,222.57 (RM707.17/ha vs 733.22); labour and amenities RM470,838.96 (RM391.16 vs 456.49, -14%); office and related RM875,904 (RM727.67 vs 703.83, +3%); other RM21,194 (RM17.61 vs 24.59). Items: staff salary RM534,189 (budget 595,561), water/electricity RM432,674 (459,194), labour paid leave RM150,329 (98,070, +53% because holiday pay uses average earnings), staff bonus RM122,718, labour recruitment RM113,062 (227,049), staff EPF RM105,528 (95,460, +11%, EPF on FY2024/25 bonus), cess/rate/rent RM103,918, labour welfare RM92,077, security RM85,911, insurance RM64,824, transport and travelling RM50,446 (22,791, 221%), donation/sponsor/entertainment RM22,255 vs RM1,800 (CSR site levelling at Kg Pulutan and Kg Saup RM5,747.49, RM10,000 condolence fund to wife of late employee Nardilius, more visitors), licence/permits RM3,938 (Genset A licence renewal), weighbridge RM18,479 (14,422; MLP 1 cost share), MSPO RM19,225 (43,060).

UPKEEP AND CULTIVATION (PA Table 6, FY2025/26, RM/ha mature 1,102.51 ha): total RM2,744,809 = RM2,489.60/ha vs budget RM2,812,772 = RM2,551.24/ha; RM161.18/t vs RM137.71/t. Upkeep supervision RM32.15/ha (37.52); weeding RM231,906 = RM210.34 (229.99); manuring RM974,446 = RM883.84 (1,442.46, 61% of budget due to delayed programme); pests and diseases RM22.54 (16.11; beneficial plants, firebreak, firefighting, security patrol in Div B); census and thinning RM4.38 (21.53); drains RM19.05 (45.13); roads and bridges RM1,124,291 = RM1,019.76 (612.31, +66%; new road by excavator and crusher-run patching by Regional Office Road Team); soil/water conservation RM107,019 = RM97.07 (30.79; 50,805 m and 442 hours of terrace harvesting paths in Div B); boundaries RM13.28 (8.62; surveyor RM6,350); pruning RM197,178 = RM178.84 (102.98; corrective pruning in rehab area); tools RM8.33 (3.81).

WEEDING (PA): circle and path spraying 2 rounds programmed = 2,205.02 ha; done 1,608.26 ha, printed 59% / 1.10 rounds (2012A 100%, 2013A 92%, 2012B 50%, 2013B 44%). Selective (blanket inter-row) 3 rounds = 3,307.53 ha; done 1,224.95 ha, 37%, 1.0 round. Delays from heavy rain Nov/Dec 2025 to Mar 2026 and sprayers diverted to manuring. Circle: Inter pump 150 ml glyphosate per 10 L; 2.40 ha/man-day at RM28/ha = RM67.20/day (optimum 4-5 ha). Mist blower 150 ml triclopyr (Kenlon) + 40 g metsulfuron (Emly) per 10 L; 2.50 ha/man-day, RM70/day. Inter-rows still dominated by Clidemia, Eupatorium, Hedyotis, Melastoma, Asystasia, VOP, Stenochlaena, bracken, sedges; Lalang, Pennisetum and Giant Paspalum being sprayed; soft grasses and Nephrolepis establishing, expected to dominate within a year.
WEEDING (Agro Table 9, 10 months to Feb 2026): selective spray 2,617.48 ha vs 1,154.85 ha programme (227%), circle 992.73 vs 2,309.70 ha (43%), lalang 149.10 vs 153.56 (97%), woody poisoning 675.87 vs 1,285.76 (53%), manual selective 987.63 vs 1,348.32 (73%). Ground not fully satisfactory (Pennisetum purpureum, Clidemia hirta); circles fair; VOPs at platforms need immediate removal; woody poisoning done in Div B, ongoing in Div A, manual in 12B-35 and 12B-36; incomplete kill and over-spraying of soft grasses on terraces in 13B-23. Immature 24B: selective 56.48 of 128.26 ha (44%), circle 91.77 of 513.04 ha (18%).

MANURING (PA Table 9, FY2025/26 to April 2026): required 1,071.17 mt, delivered 1,070.89 mt, applied 715.84 mt (67%), balance printed 361.05 mt (delivered minus applied is 355.05; the Oct-25 RP row balance 23.90 should be 17.90). Mature Mix B rounds: May 100%, Jun 100%, Aug 86%, Sep 56%, Nov 70%, Jan 57%, Feb 47%, Apr 8%; RP Jul 73%, Oct 81%. Immature rounds mostly 0-37%. Delay due to heavy rain Nov-Mar and worker shortage; buckets used on steep terrain; 20 bags/man-day at RM2.50/bag = RM50/day.
MANURING (Agro, Feb 2026): mature Mix B 396.4 of 891.7 mt (44%), RP 104.8 of 167.24 mt (63%); immature RP 0.98 of 19.81 (5%), CPD 0 of 38.77, Mix B 0.4 of 4.86 (8%), Fujicoat 0.4 of 7.85 (5%). Div B about three rounds pending (Mix B Sep 2025, Jan 2026, Apr 2026), Div A about two. Causes: machinery limits (100-120 bags per trip), worker output below 20 bags/day (13 bags/day observed in 12A13), FY2024/25 backlog in Div B finished only July 2025. Quality acceptable (little caking, lumping or narrow banding). Agro 7.1: FY25/26 programme unchanged but the April 2026 Mix B round will not be completed; stock carried forward to FY26/27 (August).

FERTILISER PROGRAMME (Agro appendices, grams per palm): FY2025/26 mature: Mix B 2000 g rounds plus RP 1500 g; 2013A field 9 Mix B 8000 g sub-soil. FY2026/27: 2012A Mix B 2000 g Jun, Sep, Jan, Mar, kieserite 1500 g Jul, RP 1500 g Nov. 2012B Mix B 2000 g May, Sep, Jan, Apr, 1500 g Aug (red, carried-forward Mix B), kieserite 1000 g Jul (B27, B32-B34), RP 1500 g Dec; B29 8000 g sub-soil. 2013A Mix B 2000 g Jun, Sep, Jan, Apr, kieserite 1000 g Jul (A03, A04, A14), RP 1500 g Nov; A03 8000 g sub-soil. 2013B Mix B 2000 g May, Aug, Nov, Feb, kieserite 1000 g Jun (B22, B38), RP 1500 g Oct. 2024B CPD 1200 g May, RP 1700 g Jul, CPD 1200 g Aug, 1500 g Nov and Feb. 2025C (99.38 ha, 120 SPH, 11,926 palms) and 2026D (131.57 ha, 15,788 palms): CRF 600 g + RP 500 g at planting, CPD 800 g and RP 1500 g at 9th month. Mix B 9.45:0:24:3.7:0.48; CPD 14:13:9:2.5.

PALM CONDITION, PEST AND DISEASE: PA - no serious rat damage, baiting unnecessary, census every 3 months; no bagworm; Ganoderma negligible. Agro - palms generally acceptable; rehab areas greener but not fully recovered; small bunches, thin trunks and low vigour in P13B-22, P12B-32, P12B-34, P13B-38, P13A-03, P13A-04; Mg deficiency (older frond yellowing) in hilly areas and new rehab in Div B; etiolation from close planting in ravines (block 23), thinning ongoing; localised rat damage on bunches, not significant.

PRUNING: PA Table 10 - 2,243.41 ha done vs 2,205.02 ha programme (100%) by April 2026; progressive pruning at RM1.00/palm/year paid in two instalments, PA recommends quarterly; dried fronds hanging in ravines. Agro Table 8 (Feb 2026) - progressive 1,467.08 ha (67%, based on payments); corrective 211.94 of 246.39 ha (86%; 12B 72%, 13B 80%); some over-pruning; frond stacking improved.

ROADS, DRAINS (PA): no grading or crusher-run surfacing all year (insufficient crusher run, weather; surfacing contractors terminated); Road Team patching on piece rate. Road maintenance 10,457.98 chains at RM53.70/chain (budget 48.28); bridge excavator 401 hrs RM83.33/hr; culvert 87 hrs RM84.23/hr (budget RM85). Agricultural roads unsurfaced, soft and slippery; quarry is on the estate. Drains: backhoe 98 hrs at RM48/hr.

HARVESTING (PA section 7): 56 harvesters in 4 groups (Div A 20 and 17, Div B 7 and 12), wheelbarrow evacuation, 4 mini-crawlers in 2013A9, A11, A14, A16 and 2012A13, A15. Intervals 7-16 days in April 2026 (Table 13); 10-15 days where roads surfaced. Output (Table 14) at RM55/t: 2012A 1.43 t/man-day RM78.65; 2013A 1.38, RM75.90; 2012B 1.52, RM83.60; second 2012B row 1.67, RM91.85; basic wage RM65.39. Agro Table 7: Feb 2026 intervals 9-14 days; 12B and 13B ran 15-31 days in mid-2025; unripe bunches, long stalks and loose fruit losses at Div B ramp and 13B-05.

HARVEST AND COLLECTION COST (PA Table 15, FY2025/26): RM2,256,852.04 = RM132.53/t vs RM131.84 budget. Supervision 4.79 (4.97), harvesting own FFB RM977,419.88 = 57.40 (59.14), infield loading 4.57 (4.15), ramp 3.87 (3.29), internal transport RM398,965.01 = 23.43 (18.23), tools 0.59 (0.86); sub-total 94.65 (90.64); external transport RM645,040.03 = 37.88 (41.20).

CROP (PA Table 16, FY2025/26 May 2025-Apr 2026): FFB 17,029.48 t vs 20,425.00 t budget (-17%); last year 14,018.28 t. Yield 15.45 t/ha vs 18.53 budget (-3.08) and 12.40 last year.
